articles.summary: British Columbia First Nations to share in the long-term economic benefits from Canadian energy infrastructure CALGARY, Alberta, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TC Energy Corporation (TSX, NYSE: TRP) (TC Energy or the Company) today announced the closing of an agreement with FN CGL Pipeline Limited Partnership, an Indigenous-led investment entity representing five First Nations along the Coastal GasLink (CGL) corridor. Through the agreement developed in collaboration with the participating Nations,...
articles.title: TC Energy announces Indigenous investment in Coastal GasLink
